name: Holographic Foil Card
description: Collectible-card foil: rainbow sheen, glare and tilt all track the pointer through CSS variables.
a11y: Purely decorative layers (aria-hidden); off on touch and reduced motion.
perf: Pointer handler writes CSS vars; no React re-renders.
prompt: Build a holographic card: on pointermove set --mx/--my (percent) and --rx/--ry (±9/±11deg) CSS vars; the card rotates in 3D from them; overlay a repeating 115° rainbow gradient at 300% size positioned by --mx/--my with mix-blend color-dodge, masked by a radial gradient at the pointer, plus a white radial glare (overlay blend). Reset on leave.

name: Flip Card
description: Two-sided card that flips in 3D on click, Enter or Space — keyboard and touch friendly, not hover-only.
a11y: A real button with aria-pressed; reduced motion crossfades faces instead of rotating.
perf: Single rotateY spring with backface-visibility hidden.
prompt: Create a flip card: a button with perspective 1000px holding a preserve-3d container that springs rotateY 0↔180 (180/20); front and back are absolutely stacked faces with backface-visibility hidden, the back pre-rotated 180°.

name: Swipe Deck
description: Tinder-style deck: drag to swipe with rotation and LIKE/NOPE stamps; buttons and arrow keys do the same.
a11y: Like/Nope buttons and ←/→ keys make the drag optional; deck changes are announced (aria-live).
perf: Only the top card is draggable; two cards preview underneath.
prompt: Build a swipe deck: top card `drag="x"` with rotate = x mapped [−200,200]→[−18,18]°, LIKE/NOPE stamps fading in from x; release past 110px or 600px/s exits it off-screen with rotation; the next two cards sit scaled .95/.9 and offset 12/24px and animate up. Add Like/Nope buttons and arrow keys.

name: Hover Reveal Card
description: Image card: on hover or focus the photo zooms and dims while a details panel slides up from the bottom.
a11y: Focusable article; identical reveal on focus-visible; text is in the DOM from the start.
prompt: Make a hover-reveal image card: image scales 1.1 and drops to brightness .5 over 700ms expo-out; the bottom text block lifts 4px and an extra details row expands with grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr then fades in. Same on :focus-visible.

name: Glass Parallax Card
description: Frosted glass card over a colorful backdrop; the backdrop and the card drift in opposite directions with the pointer.
a11y: Ensure text contrast on the frosted surface; motion off on touch/reduced motion.
perf: Two spring motion values; backdrop-filter on one element.
prompt: Create a glass card: colorful blobs behind a card with bg-white/15, border-white/30, backdrop-blur-2xl + saturate, inset top highlight. Pointer offset (−.5….5) springs the blob layer by ×−30px and the card by ×10px for parallax.

name: Neon Gradient Card
description: A two-tone neon gradient border that slowly rotates, with a matching bloom glowing behind the card.
a11y: Decorative; animation stops under reduced motion.
perf: Registered @property angle; blur on a pseudo-element.
prompt: Build a neon card: a 2px-padded wrapper painted with conic-gradient(from var(--angle), c1, c2, c1) rotating via @property, a ::before copy blurred 24px at .65 opacity behind it, and the card body inside.

name: Pixel Dissolve Card
description: A pixel mosaic covers the image and dissolves square by square in pseudo-random order on hover or focus.
a11y: Real with alt underneath; focusable; reduced motion fades all cells at once.
perf: cols×rows plain divs with opacity steps; no canvas.
prompt: Create a pixel dissolve: overlay a CSS grid of cols×rows cells over the image; on hover each cell's opacity steps to 0 with a deterministic pseudo-random delay (0–450ms), reversing on leave.

name: Expanding Gallery
description: Accordion gallery: hovering or focusing a panel grows it with a spring while siblings compress, captions fade in.
a11y: Panels are buttons with aria-expanded; activates on focus too.
perf: Flex-grow via Motion layout; images are static.
prompt: Build an expanding gallery: a flex row of image buttons; the active one has flex 5, others 1, animated with Motion layout spring; active caption fades/slides in after 150ms; collapsed panels show a vertical title.

name: 3D Layered Card
description: The card tilts toward the pointer and its child layers lift out to different depths with translateZ.
a11y: Decorative depth only; off on touch and reduced motion.
perf: Springs for rotation and a shared hover value; transforms only.
prompt: Create a 3D card with context: container springs rotateX/rotateY ±12° from pointer position with preserve-3d; a shared hover motion value (0→1) drives each `Card3DLayer`'s translateZ from 0 to its depth.

name: Card Fan
description: A tidy stack that fans out like a hand of cards on hover/focus; the card under the pointer lifts and comes forward.
a11y: Each card is focusable; fan opens on focus.
prompt: Build a card fan: cards absolutely stacked with transform-origin bottom; open state rotates each by (i−mid)·11°, x (i−mid)·58px, y |i−mid|·10px; hovered card lifts −28px, scales 1.05 and z-indexes to top. Spring 260/30.

name: Shine Sweep Card
description: A specular highlight sweeps diagonally across the card on hover — perfect for premium tiers and product tiles.
a11y: Focusable, same sweep on focus-visible; highlight hidden under reduced motion.
perf: One skewed gradient span moving via `left`.
prompt: Make a shine card: an overflow-hidden card with a skewed (−12°) half-width white/40 gradient strip parked at left −100%, transitioning to 150% over 700ms on hover/focus.

name: Profile Card
description: Profile card with a zooming cover, a Follow button that morphs to Following, and follower counts that roll.
a11y: Follow is an aria-pressed button; stats in a <dl>.
perf: Layout morph on the button; per-stat rolling text.
prompt: Create a profile card: cover image that zooms 1.1→1.25 on hover, avatar overlapping with a ring, a Follow button (Motion layout) that morphs to an outlined 'Following ✓' with a vertical label roll, and stats whose numbers roll when the follower count changes.

name: Social Post
description: Post card with spring-y like, repost and save actions whose counters roll up and down.
a11y: Each action is a labelled aria-pressed button.
prompt: Build a social post card: header (avatar, name, @handle · time), text, optional image, and an action row (reply, repost, like, save). Active actions pop scale [1,1.3,1], fill with their color, and counters roll vertically in the direction of change.

name: Folder Card
description: A folder whose flap tilts open on hover/click while the papers inside slide up and fan out.
a11y: Button with aria-expanded; opens on click for touch/keyboard.
prompt: Create a folder: back panel with a tab, up to 3 papers inside, and a front flap with transform-origin bottom. Open → flap rotateX −32°, papers rise (−48px − i·6) and fan (x (i−1)·36, rotate (i−1)·10°) with staggered springs.
